title: Объёмное образование и подозрение на опухоль
terminology: Масса является находкой, а не диагнозом; пальпация, размер, подвижность, возраст, порода и imaging не определяют доброкачественность или злокачественность сами по себе.
Каждое образование получает неизменяемый massId, слой и участок, три размера, фото с датой, темп роста, изъязвление, боль, функцию и карту регионарных лимфоузлов.
Несколько масс у одного пациента имеют независимые ID, образцы и результаты и не наследуют диагноз друг друга.
Цитология может быть диагностической, категориальной или неинформативной; кровь, некроз или низкая клеточность являются реальным результатом, а не отрицательным тестом.
Гистология сохраняет тип, grade, инвазию, митотические показатели, ориентацию образца и margins; цитология обычно не заменяет эти поля.
Grade описывает микроскопическое поведение, stage — анатомическую распространённость; они не взаимозаменяемы.
Регионарный лимфоузел выбирается по дренажу, а не только по размеру; нормальный размер не исключает метастазирование.
Staging выбирается по биологии конкретной опухоли, влиянию результата, состоянию пациента и приоритетам владельца, а не единым пакетом для всех.
Биопсийный канал и метод планируются так, чтобы не ухудшить возможность окончательной операции.
Внутренняя масса с кровотечением, обструкцией, выпотом или дисфункцией органа имеет срочный маршрут независимо от окончательного типа.
Цели владельца, стоимость, контроль симптомов, паллиативный маршрут и качество жизни являются продольным состоянием.
Система не генерирует биопсию, операцию, химиотерапию, лучевую терапию, препарат, дозу или протокол.

commonHistoryQuestions.prompt: Когда появилась каждая масса и как менялись рост, изъязвление, боль и функция?
Каковы massId, участок, слой, три размера и дата фото?
Какие отдельные ID и результаты принадлежат каждой из нескольких масс?
Как, где и когда брали образец и каков полный результат?
Есть ли кровотечение, обструкция, выпот или дисфункция органа?
Каковы вес, аппетит, температура и активность?
Какие регионарные узлы и пути дренажа оценены?
Сохранены ли тип, grade, invasion, margins и ориентация образца?
Какие сопутствующие болезни меняют безопасность вмешательства?
Какова цель владельца: излечение, контроль или паллиативная помощь?
Каковы бюджет, сроки, транспорт и возможность направления?
Как меняются функция, боль, домашнее наблюдение и качество жизни?

variants.title: Неопухолевое или воспалительное образование
variants.diagnosticTruth: Cystic, lipomatous, abscess, granulomatous and reactive lesions can resemble neoplasia; cytology, inflammation/infection evidence and a defined same-mass recheck establish the route without generalizing to future masses.

presentations.complaint: A mapped mass has cytology compatible with a cyst, lipoma or another benign pattern.

outcomes.safe: Benign interpretation remains mass-specific and monitored.
outcomes.unsafe: All current or future masses are called benign.

ownerCommunication: Explain that the sample is reassuring for this exact mass, while any change or new mass has its own identity.

presentations.complaint: Cytology or examination supports abscess, granulomatous or reactive inflammation rather than immediate neoplasia.

examFindings.finding: Inflammation is not an automatic antimicrobial diagnosis.

followUp.timing: after cause-directed review and defined clinical checkpoint

outcomes.safe: Inflammation has a cause and response route.
outcomes.unsafe: Inflammation automatically generates a drug course.

ownerCommunication: Explain that inflammation may be infectious or sterile and the cause determines the next step.

presentations.complaint: At a defined recheck the same mass resolves, persists or changes in size, pain, surface or function.

historyAnswers.mass_site_layer_three_dimensions_and_pho: Same mass and measurement method retained.

outcomes.safe: Resolution and persistence lead to different recorded routes.
outcomes.unsafe: Prior improvement proves future benignity.

ownerCommunication: Show the same-mass comparison and explain what specific change triggers new sampling.

variants.title: Неидентифицированная кожная или подкожная масса
variants.diagnosticTruth: Every undifferentiated cutaneous or subcutaneous mass is mapped and sampled or has a documented reason not to; size and mobility alter planning but never determine biology.

presentations.complaint: A small, mobile, slow-growing mass is found during examination.

historyAnswers.mass_onset_growth_change_ulceration_pain: Slow growth is reported but measured.
historyAnswers.prior_sample_method_site_and_result: No sample or result identity fixed.

followUp.timing: after sampling or defined measurement interval

outcomes.safe: Low-risk appearance is sampled or explicitly monitored.
outcomes.unsafe: Watchful waiting has no measurements or trigger.

ownerCommunication: Explain that feel and size cannot identify cell type.

presentations.complaint: A large, fixed, ulcerated or rapidly growing superficial mass threatens margins or function.

historyAnswers.cost_turnaround_transport_and_referral_f: Planned referral feasible or fallback explicit.

outcomes.safe: Biopsy protects definitive surgery.
outcomes.unsafe: The mass is cut out without diagnosis or margin planning.

ownerCommunication: Explain why a quick removal can make definitive surgery harder.

presentations.complaint: Several masses coexist with different sites, layers and growth patterns.

historyAnswers.multiple_mass_independent_identity: Each mass has its own ID.

examFindings.finding: One lipoma does not diagnose another mass.

outcomes.safe: Every mass retains independent truth.
outcomes.unsafe: All masses inherit the first diagnosis.

ownerCommunication: Label the map and explain which mass each result belongs to.

variants.title: Round-cell или mast-cell pattern
variants.diagnosticTruth: Cytology often identifies mast-cell or other round-cell morphology, while grade, invasion, margins, lineage and staging remain tumor-specific separate questions; systemic or degranulation signs change urgency.

presentations.complaint: Mass-specific cytology supports mast cell tumor morphology.

followUp.timing: after pathology and tumor-specific staging decision

outcomes.safe: Type, grade and stage remain distinct.
outcomes.unsafe: Cytology fabricates grade or margins.

ownerCommunication: Explain what cytology has identified and which prognosis fields still require tissue or selective staging.

presentations.complaint: Cytology identifies a round-cell category but not a secure lineage or subtype.

examFindings.finding: Flow/IHC chosen for a defined question.

outcomes.safe: Ancillary testing answers a defined classification question.
outcomes.unsafe: Round-cell is presented as a complete final diagnosis.

ownerCommunication: Explain that the cell family is known but a targeted laboratory method may be needed to name the subtype.

presentations.complaint: A round-cell or mast-cell pattern coexists with acute swelling, GI signs, collapse, bleeding or other systemic red flags.

followUp.timing: immediate safety route then pathology plan

outcomes.safe: Red flags trigger stabilization without inventing grade.
outcomes.unsafe: A random malignancy score replaces clinical safety.

ownerCommunication: Explain that the current systemic reaction changes urgency even before final grade is known.

variants.title: Лимфоузел или системный опухолевый паттерн
variants.diagnosticTruth: Reactive, metastatic and primary lymphoid node processes require distribution, drainage and morphology; node size is insufficient, and generalized lymphadenopathy may require flow, immunophenotype or histology.

presentations.complaint: A regional node may be reactive, metastatic or unrelated to the nearby mass.

historyAnswers.prior_sample_method_site_and_result: Primary mass and node samples distinct.

examFindings.finding: Normal and enlarged nodes can mislead.

outcomes.safe: Node truth is sampled and linked.
outcomes.unsafe: Size alone sets stage.

ownerCommunication: Explain why a normal-sized node may still need sampling and an enlarged one may be inflammatory.

presentations.complaint: Generalized lymphadenopathy creates a lymphoma pattern but infectious and reactive causes remain possible.

outcomes.safe: Lymphoma is confirmed and classified rather than inferred from distribution.
outcomes.unsafe: All generalized nodes are called lymphoma.

ownerCommunication: Explain that the pattern is concerning but infection and immune activation can look similar.

presentations.complaint: Node cytology is suspicious or ambiguous and the treatment-relevant lineage remains unresolved.

outcomes.safe: Ancillary test resolves a defined uncertainty.
outcomes.unsafe: Every ambiguous node receives every test or a guessed subtype.

ownerCommunication: Explain exactly what the additional test must answer and how it changes the plan.

variants.title: Внутренняя или орган-ассоциированная масса
variants.diagnosticTruth: Internal masses require organ-effect, patient-stability, selective imaging and site-specific sampling-risk assessment; incidental appearance is not benignity, while bleeding, obstruction, effusion or dysfunction sets urgency.

presentations.complaint: An internal mass is found incidentally without current organ dysfunction.

examFindings.finding: Clinical silence does not define biology.

outcomes.safe: Incidental mass gets proportionate characterization.
outcomes.unsafe: No symptoms means benign.

ownerCommunication: Explain that incidental means how it was found, not what it is.

presentations.complaint: An internal mass is associated with bleeding, obstruction, effusion or organ dysfunction.

examFindings.finding: Stabilization and referral precede full classification.

outcomes.safe: Critical effect is stabilized without waiting for subtype.
outcomes.unsafe: Final cancer name is awaited before referral.

ownerCommunication: Explain that the immediate threat is bleeding or organ failure, while tumor typing follows stabilization.

presentations.complaint: The internal mass may be unsafe or low-yield to sample with the available route.

outcomes.safe: Sampling is chosen for safety and utility.
outcomes.unsafe: Every internal mass is aspirated because imaging found it.

ownerCommunication: Explain both the expected benefit and site-specific risk before selecting a sample route.

variants.title: Неинформативная цитология или планирование biopsy
variants.diagnosticTruth: Nondiagnostic or categorical cytology preserves adequacy and remaining question; the next method is selected for expected yield and definitive surgical planning rather than repeating or excising blindly.

presentations.complaint: Cytology yields low cellularity, blood or necrosis without diagnostic cells.

outcomes.safe: Failure mode guides a better sample.
outcomes.unsafe: No cells is reported as no cancer.

ownerCommunication: Explain that the test did not answer the question rather than showing absence of disease.

presentations.complaint: Cytology provides mesenchymal, epithelial or indeterminate category without definitive subtype or behavior.

historyAnswers.mass_onset_growth_change_ulceration_pain: Behavioral clues recorded but not diagnostic.
historyAnswers.owner_curative_control_or_palliative_goa: Need for precision tied to decision.

outcomes.safe: Category informs the next sample without overclaiming.
outcomes.unsafe: Mesenchymal or epithelial becomes a complete diagnosis.

ownerCommunication: Explain that cytology has narrowed the family but tissue architecture is needed for the final planning fields.

presentations.complaint: The team must choose an incisional or excisional route without compromising definitive margins.

examFindings.finding: Track contamination and margin loss avoided.

outcomes.safe: Diagnostic access preserves definitive options.
outcomes.unsafe: Convenient excision creates inadequate or contaminated margins.

ownerCommunication: Explain why planning the first cut can reduce the size and cost of later definitive surgery.

variants.title: Подтверждённая опухоль: grade, stage и наблюдение
variants.diagnosticTruth: Confirmed neoplasia preserves full pathology, separates grade from stage, selects staging by tumor biology and decision impact, and connects treatment intent, surveillance, palliation and quality of life longitudinally.

presentations.complaint: Histology confirms tumor type with grade, invasion and margin information when applicable.

outcomes.safe: Complete pathology drives the next question.
outcomes.unsafe: Only cancer name remains after removal.

ownerCommunication: Review type, grade and margins separately and state that spread is a different staging question.

presentations.complaint: Confirmed tumor biology determines which regional and distant staging tests can change prognosis or treatment.

outcomes.safe: Only decision-relevant staging is performed.
outcomes.unsafe: Every tumor gets identical thoracic, abdominal and advanced imaging.

ownerCommunication: Explain what each proposed staging test could change and omit redundant tests.

presentations.complaint: A confirmed tumor enters reviewed treatment, surveillance, control or palliative quality-of-life planning.

historyAnswers.quality_of_life_function_pain_and_home_m: Function, pain and home measures serial.

examFindings.finding: Goals may change without erasing pathology.

followUp.timing: individualized reviewed cadence and event triggers

outcomes.safe: Care intent and quality of life remain explicit and revisable.
outcomes.unsafe: Chemotherapy becomes ordinary inventory or a universal protocol is generated.

ownerCommunication: Revisit what outcome matters most, what burden is acceptable and which changes trigger contact.

familyValidationRules: Reject if appearance, size, breed, palpation or imaging alone declares benignity or cancer.
Reject if multiple masses share a diagnosis without independent sample identity.
Reject if nondiagnostic cytology becomes negative or cytology automatically supplies grade, invasion and margins.
Reject if grade and stage are conflated or every tumor receives the same staging panel.
Reject if regional nodes are selected by size alone or normal size universally excludes metastasis.
Reject if biopsy method, site and track do not protect definitive margins.
Reject if removed tissue loses orientation, full histology or margin status.
Reject if external results are instant or code generates biopsy, surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, drug protocols or doses.
